image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a bright yellow-orange coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavulinopsis species). The image focuses on the upper vertical branches which are smooth, cylindrical, and slightly tapered. The background consists of blurred forest floor debris, including moss and decaying leaves, providing natural context.
